segments.contextAfter: To remove the title bar, set the title bar’s [`titleVisibility`](uititlebar/titlevisibility.md) property to [`UITitlebarTitleVisibility.hidden`](uititlebartitlevisibility/hidden.md) and the [`toolbar`](uititlebar/toolbar.md) property to `nil`.

segments.source: To remove the title bar, set the title bar’s [`titleVisibility`](uititlebar/titlevisibility.md) property to [`UITitlebarTitleVisibility.hidden`](uititlebartitlevisibility/hidden.md) and the [`toolbar`](uititlebar/toolbar.md) property to `nil`.
segments.normalizedSource: To remove the title bar, set the title bar’s [`titleVisibility`](uititlebar/titlevisibility.md) property to [`UITitlebarTitleVisibility.hidden`](uititlebartitlevisibility/hidden.md) and the [`toolbar`](uititlebar/toolbar.md) property to `nil`.

segments.source: The following code shows how to remove the title bar and its separator from the window during the setup of a new scene.
segments.normalizedSource: The following code shows how to remove the title bar and its separator from the window during the setup of a new scene.
segments.contextBefore: To remove the title bar, set the title bar’s [`titleVisibility`](uititlebar/titlevisibility.md) property to [`UITitlebarTitleVisibility.hidden`](uititlebartitlevisibility/hidden.md) and the [`toolbar`](uititlebar/toolbar.md) property to `nil`.
segments.documentTitle: Removing the title bar in your Mac app built with Mac Catalyst

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func scene(_ scene: UIScene, willConnectTo session: UISceneSession, options connectionOptions: UIScene.ConnectionOptions) { guard let windowScene = (scene as? UIWindowScene) else { return } #if targetEnvironment(macCatalyst) if let titlebar = windowScene.titlebar { titlebar.titleVisibility = .hidden titlebar.toolbar = nil } #endif } ```
